title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Structured error object emitted on stderr under `--json` and `--output ndjson`. Under pretty `--json` a top-level `schema_version` is also present; under `--output ndjson` it is omitted (records stay bare). Beyond the universal `type`/`message`/`exit_code`, an error carries variant-specific keys (e.g. `field`/`value` for input validation, `last_change_time`/`if_match_token` for a mid-air collision, `resource`/`identifier` for not-found). All extra keys are optional and keyed by `type`: branch on `type` first, then read the keys relevant to that type. For a partial-batch failure the error carries summary `succeeded`/`failed` counts; the per-element `failed[]` array is published on stdout in the command's result body, not duplicated here.

field.description: InputValidation: the offending field or CLI flag, when known.

value.description: InputValidation: the rejected value, when known.

bug_id.description: MidAirCollision: the bug whose write was rejected.

last_change_time.description: MidAirCollision: the bug's current last_change_time; re-read and retry against this.

if_match_token.description: MidAirCollision: the token the client sent, now stale.

identifier.description: NotFound: the identifier that was not found.

succeeded.description: BatchPartialFailure: count of elements that succeeded.

failed.description: BatchPartialFailure: count of elements that failed.

server.description: PinMismatch/IssuerChanged: the server whose TLS trust changed.

expected.description: PinMismatch/IssuerChanged: the expected pin or issuer.

actual.description: PinMismatch/IssuerChanged: the actual pin or issuer presented.
